messages:
anya: Quick heads-up: I'm opening a small PR to consolidate 429/timeout/context-limit guidance across errref. Found a few stale links and old SDK snippets.

sam: Thanks — can you include a short checklist in the PR description so CI know what changed?

doc-bot: Link scan: 4 broken anchors in /errref; 2 snippets missing validate markers. See /tmp/errref-1725.log

mike: I'll update the Go snippet to use context.WithTimeout + defer cancel and show prompt trimming.

jess: I can rewrite the fallback UX copy. Suggest separating "model fallback" vs "capacity/region fallback".

luis: Please add a short note about streaming disconnects: don't immediate retry, use a jittered backoff. Also a nod to Dedicated private endpoint routing differences.

anya: Plan: replace go/ts/curl snippets, add a tiny Node smoke test that asserts 429 + Retry-After, include migration footnote for Dedicated. Will tag reviewers when PR is up.

sam: Ping me once it's open and I'll fast-track the snippets:validate job.

jess: I'll preflight the copy once PR lands. Add label `docs:snippets-changed` per CI.

anya: Thanks all — PR in ~30m and I'll attach smoke test logs.
